Read: abpair.py --inrun LOG (key, metric, diff b minus a, 90 % interval, verdict); the `[ab] flip` lines show the clock of each flip, `[lane] ... ab KEY=v a wN` the windows. Replaces the pairs listed in w8/ab15.md and w8/ab15b.md.
